mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_houses (merchant_id, owner_user_id, name, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{merchantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{layoutRows}, #{layoutCols}, #{layoutLayers}, #{requestId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select distinct h.id, h.merchant_id, h.owner_user_id, h.name, h.layout_rows, h.layout_cols, h.layout_layers, h.remark, h.request_id, h.is_deleted, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time from rabbit_houses h join merchants m on m.id = h.merchant_id and m.status = 'ENABLED' join merchant_users active_mu on active_mu.merchant_id = h.merchant_id and active_mu.user_id = #{userId} and active_mu.status = 'ENABLED' left join house_users hu on hu.house_id = h.id and hu.user_id = #{userId} where (hu.user_id is not null or active_mu.role = 'OWNER') and h.is_deleted = false order by h.id desc

select id, merchant_id, owner_user_id, name, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from rabbit_houses where is_deleted = false order by id asc
select count(1) from rabbit_houses where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and is_deleted = false

select id, merchant_id, owner_user_id, name, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from rabbit_houses where create_by = #{createBy} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update rabbit_houses set name = #{name}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
update rabbit_houses set is_deleted = true, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
update rabbit_houses set owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
